methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were fetched directly on 2026-06-18 for Postman (postman.com/pricing), Insomnia (insomnia.rest/pricing), Hoppscotch (hoppscotch.com/pricing), Bruno (usebruno.com/pricing), Testfully (testfully.io/pricing), and ReadyAPI (smartbear.com/product/ready-api/pricing). Apidog's pricing page (apidog.com/pricing) rendered empty content; its prices ($9 Basic / $18 Professional / $27 Enterprise per user/month annual, Free up to 4 users) were corroborated across G2, TrustRadius, and Apidog's own blog. ReadyAPI publishes NO self-serve prices (contact-sales only); all ReadyAPI monthlyUsd are null and the indicative third-party module dollar ranges are kept in notes only, never in a price field. Insomnia Pro annual savings corrected from 15% to the officially stated 17%. Apidog's fabricated 14-day trial was removed (Free tier is forever-free). All prices USD; every accessedAt = 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Postman
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from postman.com/pricing on 2026-06-18 ($0 Free single-user, $9 Solo, $19 Team, $49 Enterprise — all paid tiers per-seat, Team/Enterprise annual-only). HIPAA and BAA (Enterprise) confirmed via blog.postman.com/postman-is-hipaa-compliant; SOC 2 Type 2 and GDPR confirmed via security.postman.com Trust Portal.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Single user only. 50 AI credits/month, API client, specs, mock servers, native Git, collection runner. AI overage $0.05/credit. No team collaboration.

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: $9/user/month billed annually (higher when billed monthly). Single user. 400 AI credits/month, data-driven testing exports, unlimited private NPM packages, custom-branded docs, unlimited custom domains.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $19/user/month, annual billing only — no monthly option. Unlimited team members. 400 AI credits/user/month, unlimited workspace viewers, basic RBAC, SDK generation, team collaboration.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $49/user/month, annual billing only. 800 pooled AI credits/user/month, API Catalog, private workspaces, advanced RBAC, audit logs, governance, private runners, SSO/SAML, SCIM. HIPAA/BAA available (Enterprise). AI overage $0.035/credit with volume pricing.

limits: Free: 1 user only, 50 AI credits/month
Solo: 1 user, 400 AI credits/month
Team: 400 AI credits/user/month, annual billing only
Enterprise: 800 pooled AI credits/user/month, annual billing only
keyFeatures: AI-native API development with a credits system
API Catalog for governance and discovery (Enterprise)
Collaborative workspaces with role-based access control
Built-in API monitoring and collection runner
enrichment.provenance: Pricing fetched from postman.com/pricing; HIPAA/BAA verified via blog.postman.com/postman-is-hipaa-compliant; SOC 2 Type 2 and GDPR via security.postman.com Trust Portal.

vendors.name: Apidog
vendors.provenance: apidog.com/pricing rendered empty on fetch; prices corroborated across G2, TrustRadius, and Apidog blog comparisons: Free (up to 4 users, forever-free), Basic $9, Professional $18, Enterprise $27 — all per user/month at annual billing (monthly billing adds roughly one-third).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Up to 4 users. Unlimited API client, mocking, collection runs, mock servers, monitors. 1 Sprint Branch per project.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $9/user/month billed annually (~$12 if billed monthly). Unlimited members, 90-day request history, up to 20 team projects, API versioning, expanded Sprint Branches.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: $18/user/month billed annually (~$24 if billed monthly). Unlimited projects, team-level shared variables, scheduled import every 10 minutes, 180-day API change history, hide Apidog branding, priority support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $27/user/month billed annually. All Professional features plus 365-day history, SSO (SAML), multiple documentation sites, unlimited scheduled tasks, customizable role permissions, Vault secrets, endpoint coverage stats. On-prem requires custom quote.

limits: Free: max 4 users, 1 Sprint Branch per project
Basic: up to 20 team projects, 90-day history
Professional: 180-day history, scheduled import every 10 min
Enterprise: 365-day history, SSO included
keyFeatures: Free plan supports up to 4 users with full collaboration (vs Postman free = 1 user)
Unified platform: design, mock, test, and document APIs in one tool
Built-in mock server and API monitoring at all tiers
OpenAPI/Swagger import and sync across all plans
enrichment.provenance: Official pricing page did not render; prices corroborated via G2, TrustRadius, and Apidog blog. Fabricated 14-day trial removed — Free tier (up to 4 users) is forever-free.

vendors.name: Insomnia
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from insomnia.rest/pricing on 2026-06-18. Maintained by Kong Inc. Pro is $12/user/month annual (page states 17% savings vs monthly); Enterprise $45/user/month annual, self-serve up to 50 users.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Free forever. Git Sync for up to 3 users; unlimited cloud/local projects, Inso CLI, unlimited collection runs and environments, 1,000 mock server requests/month, end-to-end encryption, custom linting, AI features. Extra mock requests $10 per 25,000.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $12/user/month on annual billing (page states 17% savings vs monthly, ~$14.40/user/month monthly). Unlimited users, Git Sync for all members, unlimited organizations, RBAC, 10,000 mock server requests/month.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $45/user/month billed annually. Self-serve up to 50 users; contact sales for larger teams. Kong Konnect integration, SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, SOC2 compliance access, native vault integrations (AWS, GCP, HashiCorp, Azure), unlimited mock requests.

limits: Essentials: Git Sync limited to 3 users, 1,000 mock requests/month
Pro: 10,000 mock requests/month
Enterprise self-serve capped at 50 users (contact sales beyond)
keyFeatures: End-to-end encryption on all plans including free tier
Supports REST, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, SSE in one client
Native Git Sync (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket)
Kong Konnect integration on Enterprise for API lifecycle governance
enrichment.provenance: All prices fetched directly from insomnia.rest/pricing. Pro annual savings corrected to the officially stated 17%; Enterprise annual discount not quantified on the page (left null). SOC2 access confirmed as Enterprise feature.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever free. Unlimited workspaces, collections, requests, and runners; community support. Available on Cloud and Self-Host (open source).

plans.name: Organization
plans.notes: $6/user/month billed annually ($72/year/user, 25% off vs ~$8 monthly). Everything in Free plus admin dashboard, dedicated support, custom payment options. Cloud or Self-Host.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Self-hosted Enterprise Edition with advanced admin controls. No published price — contact sales.

limits: Free: community support only
Organization: admin dashboard gated to paid tier
No stated request or collection limits on any tier
keyFeatures: Open-source with full self-hosting option
Lightweight browser-based and desktop client
Unlimited collections, workspaces, and requests on free plan
Admin dashboard and dedicated support on Organization plan
enrichment.provenance: Fetched from hoppscotch.com/pricing. Compliance not publicly stated; Enterprise is contact-sales only. Enterprise source repointed from /products/enterprise (which redirects to a generic landing page) to the verified pricing page.

vendors.name: Bruno
vendors.provenance: Prices fetched directly from usebruno.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Git-native, offline-first; open-source core free. Pro $6 and Ultimate $11 per user/month billed annually. 14-day Ultimate trial (no credit card) confirmed.

plans.name: Open Source
plans.notes: Free forever. Full HTTP/REST/GraphQL/gRPC client, testing, scripting, auth, secret management, code generation, history. 2 workspaces, 5 OpenAPI syncs/month, public collections only.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $6/user/month billed annually. Native Git integration (public and private), unlimited workspaces, unlimited collection runner, unlimited OpenAPI syncs, user management (2 license admins), 48-hour support SLA.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: $11/user/month billed annually. All Pro features plus SSO, SCIM, audit logs, CSV upload, 24-hour support SLA, custom terms/DPA, security review, PO and invoicing. 14-day free trial (no credit card).

limits: Open Source: 2 workspaces, 5 OpenAPI syncs/month, public collections only
Pro: 2 license admins for user management
Ultimate: full SSO/SCIM for enterprise identity management
keyFeatures: Git-native: collections stored as plain text files in your repo
Offline-first — no data sent to Bruno servers on free tier
Supports gRPC, GraphQL, REST, WebSocket in one client
Open-source core with optional paid cloud team features
enrichment.provenance: All plan prices fetched directly from usebruno.com/pricing; 14-day Ultimate trial confirmed. GDPR acknowledgment from privacy policy; no SOC2 or HIPAA certifications found publicly.

plans.name: Developer

API monitoring credits sold separately
Enterprise: no stated feature limits

BAA available on Enterprise for healthcare customers
Offline (air-gapped) and cloud modes both certified compliant
Add-on monitoring credits with no bundled overages

plans.name: ReadyAPI Test (Floating License)
plans.notes: Annual floating license for CI/CD and containerized environments. No official published price (contact sales). Third-party indicative estimate ~$6,599/year/seat (unverified); required for VM/Docker/Kubernetes usage.

plans.name: ReadyAPI Performance
plans.notes: Load/performance testing module licensed separately. No official published price (contact sales). Third-party indicative estimate ~$7,389–$22,199/year fixed at 250 VUs (unverified); higher for floating.

plans.name: ReadyAPI Virtualization
plans.notes: API/service virtualization module licensed separately. No official published price (contact sales). Third-party indicative estimate ~$1,415–$1,700/year fixed per seat (unverified).
